Container.Name: Ontologist
Container.Overview: AI-powered study platform for mastering Palantir Foundry. 238 flashcards, 310 quiz questions, 12 hands-on labs, mock interviews, and an AI tutor — all personalized to your background.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Ontologist web interface.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal port the app listens on. Must match the Web UI Port.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Your Anthropic API key. Required for AI features (tutor, interviews, lab review, resume parsing).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database.
